blocks.source: Canto XV
blocks.translation: Canto XV

blocks.source: Ora cen porta l’un de’ duri margini;
blocks.translation: Now bears us onward one of the hard margins,

blocks.source: e ’l fummo del ruscel di sopra aduggia,
blocks.translation: And so the brooklet’s mist o’ershadows it,

blocks.source: sì che dal foco salva l’acqua e li argini.
blocks.translation: From fire it saves the water and the dikes.

blocks.source: Quali Fiamminghi tra Guizzante e Bruggia,
blocks.translation: Even as the Flemings, ’twixt Cadsand and Bruges,

blocks.source: temendo ’l fiotto che ’nver’ lor s’avventa,
blocks.translation: Fearing the flood that tow’rds them hurls itself,

blocks.source: fanno lo schermo perché ’l mar si fuggia;
blocks.translation: Their bulwarks build to put the sea to flight;

blocks.source: e quali Padoan lungo la Brenta,
blocks.translation: And as the Paduans along the Brenta,

blocks.source: per difender lor ville e lor castelli,
blocks.translation: To guard their villas and their villages,

blocks.source: anzi che Carentana il caldo senta:
blocks.translation: Or ever Chiarentana feel the heat;

blocks.source: a tale imagine eran fatti quelli,
blocks.translation: In such similitude had those been made,

blocks.source: tutto che né sì alti né sì grossi,
blocks.translation: Albeit not so lofty nor so thick,

blocks.source: qual che si fosse, lo maestro félli.
blocks.translation: Whoever he might be, the master made them.

blocks.source: Già eravam da la selva rimossi
blocks.translation: Now were we from the forest so remote,

blocks.source: tanto, ch’i’ non avrei visto dov’ era,
blocks.translation: I could not have discovered where it was,

blocks.source: perch’ io in dietro rivolto mi fossi,
blocks.translation: Even if backward I had turned myself,

blocks.source: quando incontrammo d’anime una schiera
blocks.translation: When we a company of souls encountered,

blocks.source: che venian lungo l’argine, e ciascuna
blocks.translation: Who came beside the dike, and every one

blocks.source: ci riguardava come suol da sera
blocks.translation: Gazed at us, as at evening we are wont

blocks.source: guardare uno altro sotto nuova luna;
blocks.translation: To eye each other under a new moon,

blocks.source: e sì ver’ noi aguzzavan le ciglia
blocks.translation: And so towards us sharpened they their brows

blocks.source: come ’l vecchio sartor fa ne la cruna.
blocks.translation: As an old tailor at the needle’s eye.

blocks.source: Così adocchiato da cotal famiglia,
blocks.translation: Thus scrutinised by such a family,

blocks.source: fui conosciuto da un, che mi prese
blocks.translation: By some one I was recognised, who seized

blocks.source: per lo lembo e gridò: «Qual maraviglia!».
blocks.translation: My garment’s hem, and cried out, “What a marvel!”

blocks.source: E io, quando ’l suo braccio a me distese,
blocks.translation: And I, when he stretched forth his arm to me,

blocks.source: ficcaï li occhi per lo cotto aspetto,
blocks.translation: On his baked aspect fastened so mine eyes,

blocks.source: sì che ’l viso abbrusciato non difese
blocks.translation: That the scorched countenance prevented not

blocks.source: la conoscenza süa al mio ’ntelletto;
blocks.translation: His recognition by my intellect;

blocks.source: e chinando la mano a la sua faccia,
blocks.translation: And lowering my hand unto his face,

blocks.source: rispuosi: «Siete voi qui, ser Brunetto?».
blocks.translation: I made reply, “Are you here, Ser Brunetto?”

blocks.source: E quelli: «O figliuol mio, non ti dispiaccia
blocks.translation: And he: “May’t not displease thee, O my son,

blocks.source: se Brunetto Latino un poco teco
blocks.translation: If a brief space with thee Brunetto Latini

blocks.source: ritorna ’n dietro e lascia andar la traccia».
blocks.translation: Backward return and let the trail go on.”

blocks.source: I’ dissi lui: «Quanto posso, ven preco;
blocks.translation: I said to him: “With all my power I ask it;

blocks.source: e se volete che con voi m’asseggia,
blocks.translation: And if you wish me to sit down with you,

blocks.source: faròl, se piace a costui che vo seco».
blocks.translation: I will, if he please, for I go with him.”

blocks.source: «O figliuol», disse, «qual di questa greggia
blocks.translation: “O son,” he said, “whoever of this herd

blocks.source: s’arresta punto, giace poi cent’ anni
blocks.translation: A moment stops, lies then a hundred years,

blocks.source: sanz’ arrostarsi quando ’l foco il feggia.
blocks.translation: Nor fans himself when smiteth him the fire.

blocks.source: Però va oltre: i’ ti verrò a’ panni;
blocks.translation: Therefore go on; I at thy skirts will come,

blocks.source: e poi rigiugnerò la mia masnada,
blocks.translation: And afterward will I rejoin my band,

blocks.source: che va piangendo i suoi etterni danni».
blocks.translation: Which goes lamenting its eternal doom.”

blocks.source: Io non osava scender de la strada
blocks.translation: I did not dare to go down from the road

blocks.source: per andar par di lui; ma ’l capo chino
blocks.translation: Level to walk with him; but my head bowed

blocks.source: tenea com’ uom che reverente vada.
blocks.translation: I held as one who goeth reverently.

blocks.source: El cominciò: «Qual fortuna o destino
blocks.translation: And he began: “What fortune or what fate

blocks.source: anzi l’ultimo dì qua giù ti mena?
blocks.translation: Before the last day leadeth thee down here?

blocks.source: e chi è questi che mostra ’l cammino?».
blocks.translation: And who is this that showeth thee the way?”

blocks.source: «Là sù di sopra, in la vita serena»,
blocks.translation: “Up there above us in the life serene,”

blocks.source: rispuos’ io lui, «mi smarri’ in una valle,
blocks.translation: I answered him, “I lost me in a valley,

blocks.source: avanti che l’età mia fosse piena.
blocks.translation: Or ever yet my age had been completed.

blocks.source: Pur ier mattina le volsi le spalle:
blocks.translation: But yestermorn I turned my back upon it;

blocks.source: questi m’apparve, tornand’ ïo in quella,
blocks.translation: This one appeared to me, returning thither,

blocks.source: e reducemi a ca per questo calle».
blocks.translation: And homeward leadeth me along this road.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Se tu segui tua stella,
blocks.translation: And he to me: “If thou thy star do follow,

blocks.source: non puoi fallire a glorïoso porto,
blocks.translation: Thou canst not fail thee of a glorious port,

blocks.source: se ben m’accorsi ne la vita bella;
blocks.translation: If well I judged in the life beautiful.

blocks.source: e s’io non fossi sì per tempo morto,
blocks.translation: And if I had not died so prematurely,

blocks.source: veggendo il cielo a te così benigno,
blocks.translation: Seeing Heaven thus benignant unto thee,

blocks.source: dato t’avrei a l’opera conforto.
blocks.translation: I would have given thee comfort in the work.

blocks.source: Ma quello ingrato popolo maligno
blocks.translation: But that ungrateful and malignant people,

blocks.source: che discese di Fiesole ab antico,
blocks.translation: Which of old time from Fesole descended,

blocks.source: e tiene ancor del monte e del macigno,
blocks.translation: And smacks still of the mountain and the granite,

blocks.source: ti si farà, per tuo ben far, nimico;
blocks.translation: Will make itself, for thy good deeds, thy foe;

blocks.source: ed è ragion, ché tra li lazzi sorbi
blocks.translation: And it is right; for among crabbed sorbs

blocks.source: si disconvien fruttare al dolce fico.
blocks.translation: It ill befits the sweet fig to bear fruit.

blocks.source: Vecchia fama nel mondo li chiama orbi;
blocks.translation: Old rumour in the world proclaims them blind;

blocks.source: gent’ è avara, invidiosa e superba:
blocks.translation: A people avaricious, envious, proud;

blocks.source: dai lor costumi fa che tu ti forbi.
blocks.translation: Take heed that of their customs thou do cleanse thee.

blocks.source: La tua fortuna tanto onor ti serba,
blocks.translation: Thy fortune so much honour doth reserve thee,

blocks.source: che l’una parte e l’altra avranno fame
blocks.translation: One party and the other shall be hungry

blocks.source: di te; ma lungi fia dal becco l’erba.
blocks.translation: For thee; but far from beak shall be the grass.

blocks.source: Faccian le bestie fiesolane strame
blocks.translation: Their litter let the beasts of Fesole

blocks.source: di lor medesme, e non tocchin la pianta,
blocks.translation: Make of themselves, nor let them touch the plant,

blocks.source: s’alcuna surge ancora in lor letame,
blocks.translation: If any still upon their dunghill rise,

blocks.source: in cui riviva la sementa santa
blocks.translation: In which may yet revive the consecrated

blocks.source: di que’ Roman che vi rimaser quando
blocks.translation: Seed of those Romans, who remained there when

blocks.source: fu fatto il nido di malizia tanta».
blocks.translation: The nest of such great malice it became.”

blocks.source: «Se fosse tutto pieno il mio dimando»,
blocks.translation: “If my entreaty wholly were fulfilled,”

blocks.source: rispuos’ io lui, «voi non sareste ancora
blocks.translation: Replied I to him, “not yet would you be

blocks.source: de l’umana natura posto in bando;
blocks.translation: In banishment from human nature placed;

blocks.source: ché ’n la mente m’è fitta, e or m’accora,
blocks.translation: For in my mind is fixed, and touches now

blocks.source: la cara e buona imagine paterna
blocks.translation: My heart the dear and good paternal image

blocks.source: di voi quando nel mondo ad ora ad ora
blocks.translation: Of you, when in the world from hour to hour

blocks.source: m’insegnavate come l’uom s’etterna:
blocks.translation: You taught me how a man becomes eternal;

blocks.source: e quant’ io l’abbia in grado, mentr’ io vivo
blocks.translation: And how much I am grateful, while I live

blocks.source: convien che ne la mia lingua si scerna.
blocks.translation: Behoves that in my language be discerned.

blocks.source: Ciò che narrate di mio corso scrivo,
blocks.translation: What you narrate of my career I write,

blocks.source: e serbolo a chiosar con altro testo
blocks.translation: And keep it to be glossed with other text

blocks.source: a donna che saprà, s’a lei arrivo.
blocks.translation: By a Lady who can do it, if I reach her.

blocks.source: Tanto vogl’ io che vi sia manifesto,
blocks.translation: This much will I have manifest to you;

blocks.source: pur che mia coscïenza non mi garra,
blocks.translation: Provided that my conscience do not chide me,

blocks.source: ch’a la Fortuna, come vuol, son presto.
blocks.translation: I am prepared for Fortune, as she wills.

blocks.source: Non è nuova a li orecchi miei tal arra:
blocks.translation: Such handsel is not new unto mine ears;

blocks.source: però giri Fortuna la sua rota
blocks.translation: Therefore let Fortune turn her wheel around

blocks.source: come le piace, e ’l villan la sua marra».
blocks.translation: As it may please her, and the churl his mattock.”

blocks.source: Lo mio maestro allora in su la gota
blocks.translation: My Master thereupon on his right cheek

blocks.source: destra si volse in dietro e riguardommi;
blocks.translation: Did backward turn himself, and looked at me;

blocks.source: poi disse: «Bene ascolta chi la nota».
blocks.translation: Then said: “He listeneth well who noteth it.”

blocks.source: Né per tanto di men parlando vommi
blocks.translation: Nor speaking less on that account, I go

blocks.source: con ser Brunetto, e dimando chi sono
blocks.translation: With Ser Brunetto, and I ask who are

blocks.source: li suoi compagni più noti e più sommi.
blocks.translation: His most known and most eminent companions.

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Saper d’alcuno è buono;
blocks.translation: And he to me: “To know of some is well;

blocks.source: de li altri fia laudabile tacerci,
blocks.translation: Of others it were laudable to be silent,

blocks.source: ché ’l tempo saria corto a tanto suono.
blocks.translation: For short would be the time for so much speech.

blocks.source: In somma sappi che tutti fur cherci
blocks.translation: Know them in sum, that all of them were clerks,

blocks.source: e litterati grandi e di gran fama,
blocks.translation: And men of letters great and of great fame,

blocks.source: d’un peccato medesmo al mondo lerci.
blocks.translation: In the world tainted with the selfsame sin.

blocks.source: Priscian sen va con quella turba grama,
blocks.translation: Priscian goes yonder with that wretched crowd,

blocks.source: e Francesco d’Accorso anche; e vedervi,
blocks.translation: And Francis of Accorso; and thou hadst seen there

blocks.source: s’avessi avuto di tal tigna brama,
blocks.translation: If thou hadst had a hankering for such scurf,

blocks.source: colui potei che dal servo de’ servi
blocks.translation: That one, who by the Servant of the Servants

blocks.source: fu trasmutato d’Arno in Bacchiglione,
blocks.translation: From Arno was transferred to Bacchiglione,

blocks.source: dove lasciò li mal protesi nervi.
blocks.translation: Where he has left his sin-excited nerves.

blocks.source: Di più direi; ma ’l venire e ’l sermone
blocks.translation: More would I say, but coming and discoursing

blocks.source: più lungo esser non può, però ch’i’ veggio
blocks.translation: Can be no longer; for that I behold

blocks.source: là surger nuovo fummo del sabbione.
blocks.translation: New smoke uprising yonder from the sand.

blocks.source: Gente vien con la quale esser non deggio.
blocks.translation: A people comes with whom I may not be;

blocks.source: Sieti raccomandato il mio Tesoro,
blocks.translation: Commended unto thee be my Tesoro,

blocks.source: nel qual io vivo ancora, e più non cheggio».
blocks.translation: In which I still live, and no more I ask.”

blocks.source: Poi si rivolse, e parve di coloro
blocks.translation: Then he turned round, and seemed to be of those

blocks.source: che corrono a Verona il drappo verde
blocks.translation: Who at Verona run for the Green Mantle

blocks.source: per la campagna; e parve di costoro
blocks.translation: Across the plain; and seemed to be among them

blocks.source: quelli che vince, non colui che perde.
blocks.translation: The one who wins, and not the one who loses.
